open_points.subject: bootstrap_first_administrator
open_points.text: - bootstrap_first_administrator: [SECURITY_BOUNDARY] MUST retain the supplied password only in hashed form and MUST NOT let that password or its hash reach standard output, standard error, a log, an audit record, a returned value or an exception message.
open_points.other_text: - bootstrap_first_administrator: [VALIDATION_ERROR] MUST raise BootstrapAlreadyCompletedError, and never the input rejection, when the port reports an already initialized store, so a repeat attempt changes nothing and the caller can tell a second run apart from a mistyped address. IdentityInputRejected stays reserved for the supplied email and password. A genuine storage failure MUST propagate unchanged and MUST NOT be turned into either refusal. BootstrapAlreadyCompletedError is this module's own exception, defined here at top level as a plain Exception subclass whose body is pass and raised without arguments; it is not imported.
open_points.question: If a genuine storage failure contains the supplied password hash in its exception message, must it propagate unchanged, or must the function prevent the hash from reaching the exception message?
